records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Cancellation confirmed. If there's anything we could've done differently, I'd appreciate hearing it -- always trying to get better.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Silver Group
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Three Wrenfield outreaches (email:ebd04ac1, email:46a4c91e, email:584c1794) with zero customer replies, no tickets, and 6 days with no project, no invite, no milestone. Silence plus three stall reasons suggests low self-serve momentum in the remaining 8 days, though Starter self-activation is still possible.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first project started
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Checking back in after my last note. Nothing has come through from your side yet, so I wanted to keep this simple: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is really the thing that makes the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to follow it.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you live and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
